title.suggested: Preview of the Mace-Coburn Fight Mentions Allen

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted a New York Sun preview of the Jem Mace-Joe Coburn fight backing Coburn, noting in passing that Coburn had worn down Mike McCoole before Tom Allen finished him.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'Daily Democrat, Thursday Morning, April 20, 1871'

notes: The current title and summary are wrong: nothing about a Mace-Heenan exhibition or Allen beating Mace in twenty minutes appears. Allen's only mention: Coburn 'took the starch out of McCoole before Tom Allen finished him.'
